title: New directed strongly regular graphs on 60 vertices
summary: We prove the existence of directed strongly regular graphs with parameters (60,21,11,6,8), (60,22,12,8,8), (60,24,10,9,10), (60,25,17,8,12), (60,27,21,12,12) and (60,28,20,14,12). The group $S_5 \times 2$ acts transitively on the constructed graphs.
